### The Reign of a Wicked Queen
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/Reign-of-a-Wicked-Queen
Passage: 2 Kings 11:1
Points:
- Athaliah sought to eliminate the entire royal family to secure power after her son Ahaziah died.
- God preserved the messianic line of David through the quick thinking and courage of Joash's aunt, Jehosheba.
- Hidden away safely in the temple for six years, Joash was protected from his murderous grandmother.
- Jehoiada the priest eventually crowned the rightful heir and led a widespread covenant renewal and reformation.
- God uses ordinary people to fulfill His promises and ensure that the everlasting kingdom of Christ cannot fail.
